correctness.rationale: For every r>=2 the first idempotent row of the cyclic r-fold trivial extension is Lambda plus D Lambda, so Enomoto's arbitrary-idempotent Ext comparison and Tor duality apply verbatim. A direct cyclic Frobenius-pairing argument proves self-injectivity over a commutative artinian base. Over a field the standard Nakayama shift has exact outer order r because its quotient action cyclically permutes the factors of A^r, which no inner automorphism can do.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Enomoto proves only the r=2 reduction, while Chan-Darpö-Iyama-Marczinzik provide the r-fold structural facts. Targeted searches did not locate the all-r TC2-to-ARC reduction, fixed Nakayama cycle-length equivalence, or counterexample propagation across every finite Nakayama period. The shortness of the deduction creates a significant contemporaneous-priority risk.

value.rationale: The result shows that every prescribed nontrivial Nakayama cycle length is already universal-hard for TC2: proving TC2 on that single basic self-injective cycle type would prove universal ARC, and any ARC counterexample would propagate to TC2 counterexamples of every exact finite Nakayama outer period r>=2.
